sloka: सिंह शार्दूल चरितम् मत्त मातंग सेवितम् ।मत्त द्विज गण उद् धुष्टम् सलिल उत्पीड संकुलम् ॥४-६७-४१॥
transliteration: siṁha śārdūla caritam matta mātaṁga sevitam ।matta dvija gaṇa ud dhuṣṭam salila utpīḍa saṁkulam ॥4-67-41॥

translations.english: The son of Maruta, who was as eminent as the Windgod, the crusher of enemies ascended the great mountain Mahendra, full of grassland inhabited by deer, thickly grown with various trees and creepers full of fragrant flowers and fruits, where roam lions and tigers and proud elephants, a place that echoes with sounds of intoxicated birds and waterfalls.
